name: The Horde Needs Wool Bandages!
label: Quest
description: The Horde Needs Wool Bandages!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, adventurer. In preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj, I am here coordinating the Horde's efforts at gathering wool bandages. Unfortunately, out in the field, our soldiers cannot afford to rely upon the presence of a healer to keep them alive. Trust me, I know first hand. Thus, we're putting together all of these first aid kits for them.
If you have the time, I need many wool bandages. Return them to me here and I will see to it that you are properly rewarded.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, adventurer, have you returned so quickly with the wool bandages?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have my thanks, adventurer, and the gratitude of the Horde. If you come across more wool bandages bring them to me here should you wish to further contribute to the war effort. Until then, may your ancestors watch over you!
